proposal.density: full mixture in raw parameter units, with all adapter and standardization Jacobians

conditional.validation_cases: same 16 audit panels and 4 stress panels as original baseline
conditional.acceptance: Both the first 2048 proposals and the full 8192 precision run must pass unchanged gates. Participant and SIR calibration use the same 2048-proposal budget.

calibration.scope: SBC ranks for the complete finite-pool sampling-importance-resampling algorithm; pooled resamples are not IID exact posterior draws

test.access: Generate and evaluate only after this correction protocol passes every validation gate. The old posterior test remains untouched.

reference.thresholds: unchanged baseline reference gates; no automatic refinement on a failed new test

stop_rule: One frozen checkpoint, mixture, budget and seed. No clipping weights, training, seed/budget sweeps or automatic expansion. Save failures and stop. A passing corrected pipeline does not accept the raw neural posterior or select the final tutorial curriculum.
